Guild Overview

Bonnie and Clyde! We are life partners who started playing this game together. We've made a few friends and whats nicer than making a posse with them! We are open for everyone of level 30 or higher (just to know you are a steady player). We are 20 and 28 years of age, so I don't know if you will feel at home when you 13 or something like that, but your still welcome.
